purpose: Evidence checklist for blind store-sales backtests. Missing data is never silently scored as zero or invented.
benchmark_policy: Hide actual store revenue from feature collection and prediction until after forecast is frozen.

road_network: MnDOT measured AADT on frontage road and nearby highways separately
hourly/daypart and weekend traffic if available
distance and driving time to highway ramps/intersections
construction, detours and permanent access changes
customer_market: 21+ catchment population at 5/10/15 minute drive times
ethnicity and race distributions used only as validated aggregate market evidence, never individual targeting
household income and adult-person income distinct
smoking, vaping, cigars, chew and nicotine pouch demand separately
purchase frequency and category spend with source and uncertainty
competitive_context: all licensed specialty tobacco/vape shops with actual operating verification
gas station and convenience store tobacco/vape offerings
competitor assortment, price and hours where verified
anchors: grocery and liquor store traffic generators
Holiday, QuikTrip, Speedway and independent gas locations
regulatory: local licensing eligibility, caps and buffers
municipality exclusion list for new openings
observed_validation: monthly gross sales and transaction counts
holdout-city accuracy with absolute percentage error

special_notes.Zimmerman: 26219 Fremont Dr Ste 101. Separately validate Highway 169 vs Fremont Drive traffic and 2025-2026 Highway 169/County Road 4 construction/access changes. Nearby Holiday gas and liquor co-tenancy.
special_notes.Litchfield: 231 N Sibley Ave. Include Sibley frontage counts, competing gas stations, regional customer draw, and user's observed transaction benchmark.

missing_data_policy: For each factor emit measured / verified qualitative / assumption / unavailable, with source, year, and confidence. Do not claim a sales accuracy percentage without a held-out numeric prediction.
